highlights.text: New look for Home, Apps, History, Plans and Settings, with clearer cards and charts.
Try a what-if on a plan, see which plan runs ahead of its pace, and tap a plan to bring it to the front.
Setting up a plan takes five calm steps, and onboarding takes three.
Every chart bar shows its value, and this What's new sheet works offline.
Archived plans are restored, and deleting a plan can be undone.
Text is readable in every theme, and no empty screen flashes while data loads.
Updates row in Settings points to your app store or GitHub releases, still completely offline.
Long-press the version in Settings to copy an in-memory navigation log for bug reports.
Smooth predictive back gesture, expressive unit pickers, and animated list transitions.
Refined loading indicator, icon button press morphs, and smoother navigation bar motion.
Fixed tab switching animations, drifted tab taps on Apps, and duplicate back-stack tabs.
